description_en: Modifies the name, description, or Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of a replication pair-consistent group
description_zh: 修改一致性复制组的名称、描述信息或者RPO
kebab_example: aliyun ebs modify-disk-replica-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --replica-group-id pg-myreplica0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDiskReplicaGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the replication pair-consistent group
parameters.help_zh: 一致性复制组所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replication pair-consistent group. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426614.html to query the IDs of replication pair-consistent groups
parameters.help_zh: 一致性复制组ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426614.html查询一致性复制组ID
parameters.name: replica_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the replication pair-consistent group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 一致性复制组名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the replication pair-consistent group. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 一致性组的描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The recovery point objective (RPO) of the replication pair-consistent group. Unit: seconds. A value of 900 is supported
parameters.help_zh: 一致性组设定的RPO值，单位：秒。当前仅支持900秒
parameters.name: rpo

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth. Unit: Kbps.

This parameter is not available
parameters.help_zh:
带宽值，单位Kbps。
该参数暂未开放使用
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable replication time control (RTC). Valid values:

false: RTC is disabled.

true: RTC is enabled.

If this parameter is set to true, RTC is enabled for the replication pair-consistent group. RTC is also enabled for all asynchronous replication pairs that are added to the group
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启复制时间控制（RTC）。取值范围：

false：关闭。
true：开启。

如果设置为ture，表示一致性组开启复制时间控制（RTC），加入该一致性组的异步复制对均开启RTC
parameters.name: enable_rtc
